title: Real-Time Geospatial Streaming & Viewport-Filtered Live Telemetry
goal: Upgrade the system from inefficient 60-second polling to real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSockets, delivering low-latency geospatial event deltas filtered by client map viewport and active route buffer.

issues.title: [Sprint 7] High-Throughput Server-Sent Events (SSE) Telemetry Stream Gateway
issues.description: Replace HTTP polling with a persistent HTTP/2 Server-Sent Events endpoint (`GET /api/v1/telemetry/stream`) using `sse-starlette` or native FastAPI streaming. Deliver JSON event packets (`event: incident_update`, `event: velocity_shift`, `event: route_alert`) with automated 15-second keepalive pings (`:keepalive`) to prevent NAT/cellular carrier connection drops.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint accepts client connection and emits structured SSE events with distinct event types
Sends periodic keepalive heartbeats every 15s to keep mobile connections open
Gracefully handles client disconnections without leaking memory or coroutines in backend
Latency from incident creation in backend to event delivery on connected client is < 500ms

issues.title: [Sprint 7] Viewport-Aware Geospatial Pub/Sub Channel Filtering (BBox Subscription)
issues.description: Broadcasting all Metro Manila incident events to every connected mobile device exhausts mobile bandwidth and client CPU. Enhance `/api/v1/telemetry/stream` to accept dynamic viewport query parameters (`min_lng`, `min_lat`, `max_lng`, `max_lat`). When an incident or speed delta occurs, only publish to clients whose active map viewport intersects the event location.
acceptance_criteria: Clients subscribe with dynamic bounding box coordinates representing their visible screen
Server spatial filter matches new incident points against client subscription bounds using fast bbox intersection
Clients outside the event bounding box do not receive the payload, reducing data transfer by 80%+
Client pan/zoom updates subscription bbox via lightweight query parameter renegotiation

issues.title: [Sprint 7] Live Active Route Buffer Subscriptions & Real-Time Chokepoint Reroute Alerts
issues.description: When a commuter has an active analyzed route (e.g. Quezon City Circle to Makati), any sudden roadblock occurring directly on their corridor (within a 100m buffer of their route line) must trigger an immediate high-priority warning (`event: route_obstruction`). Compute route line buffer on route analysis and allow clients to subscribe to route-specific alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Backend associates route GeoJSON with an ephemeral route channel subscription ID
New incidents within 100m of the active route polyline emit `event: route_obstruction` to the route subscriber
Payload includes estimated added delay in minutes and a recommendation to evaluate alternate corridors
Frontend triggers visual telemetry flash warning and offers instant 1-click alternative reroute

issues.title: [Sprint 7] Frontend Streaming Hook (`useLiveTelemetryStream`) with Reconnect Backoff & Pulsar Telemetry
issues.description: Create custom React hook `useLiveTelemetryStream` in `frontend/src/hooks/useLiveTelemetryStream.ts` replacing `useTrafficRefresh`. Connects to SSE endpoint using `EventSource` with exponential backoff reconnection (1s -> 2s -> 4s -> max 16s). Updates state stores directly, triggering smooth MapLibre GeoJSON updates without re-renders. Header connection dot pulses emerald when live, amber when reconnecting, and slate when offline.
acceptance_criteria: Hook establishes and maintains stable SSE connection across mobile viewport shifts
Automatic reconnection with exponential backoff on intermittent cellular signal loss
New incidents immediately appear on map and in Incident Timeline accordion without page refresh
Header pulsar micro-badge visually communicates real-time connection status conforming to DESIGN.md

issues.title: [Sprint 7] Dynamic Congestion Heatmap Vector Layer Streaming via GeoJSON Delta Updates
issues.description: Instead of fetching the full Metro Manila road network GeoJSON on every toggle, stream corridor speed updates via delta patches (`[segment_id, current_speed, traffic_level]`). Update MapLibre source feature states in-memory (`map.setFeatureState`) to smoothly transition road segment colors (Green -> Amber -> Orange -> Red) at 60 FPS without redrawing the vector tile layer.
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap toggle consumes speed deltas and updates feature state properties in MapLibre GL
Color transitions on road segments render smoothly without canvas blinking or frame drops
Payload size for city-wide speed updates reduced from > 200 KB GeoJSON to < 12 KB delta packet
Tooltips on road segments reflect real-time streamed velocity immediately
